chars.MOM: MOM: a Moroccan mother in her late 40s wearing a burgundy hijab, thin gold-rimmed glasses, a navy-blue office blazer over a white blouse, a grey pencil skirt.
chars.GIRL: GIRL: a 17-year-old Moroccan girl wearing an oversized lavender hoodie with a big white star on the chest, light-blue ripped jeans, chunky white sneakers, small gold hoop earrings.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from a half-open doorway in a middle-class Moroccan apartment living room: MOM sits on a sofa holding a smartphone close to her face, frowning with deep suspicion at the screen, one eyebrow raised, mid-scroll. Head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Inside a Moroccan bank office: MOM sits behind her desk at work, leaning toward her computer monitor (screen turned away from the viewer), eyes narrowed, pen in hand, as if checking an account carefully. Head-to-waist framing.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: A teenage girl's bedroom at night in a Moroccan apartment: GIRL sits cross-legged on her bed, a phone on a small tripod ring light facing her, a fan of banknotes in her hands, grinning but glancing nervously at the closed bedroom door.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Afternoon in the Moroccan living room with mint tea on a low table: MOM and GIRL sit on the sofa; MOM turns toward GIRL with a serious, searching look, hand raised as if asking a question; GIRL freezes holding her tea glass.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan living room: MOM stands holding up her smartphone toward GIRL (screen facing away from the viewer), stern accusing expression, other hand on her hip; GIRL sits on the sofa looking up guilty and startled.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot in the Moroccan living room: GIRL sits frozen on the sofa, eyes wide, a drop of sweat on her forehead, hands clutching her hoodie sleeves, mouth slightly open, totally speechless.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan living room: GIRL smiles a big forced fake smile and gestures toward an open laptop showing rows of clothes on an online shop page (no readable text), explaining eagerly; MOM listens with crossed arms, slightly squinting, half convinced.
